about_the_game:
SPARTAN GAMES - Fair Play Guarantee

AEXXOS is 100% no pay-to-win. Any real-money purchases are purely cosmetic—account-

locked ship skins and vanity items—so every spaceship, ammunition and upgrade must be earned through gameplay. Your skill and strategy, not your wallet, decide your fate in the Galaxy.

What is AEXXOS?

Strap into the captain’s chair and command your destiny in AEXXOS. From your starship’s bridge, you’ll chart hyperspace routes, accept daring missions, and engage in heart-pounding PvP battles. Dock at bustling space stations to barter resources, coordinate fleet maneuvers with fellow captains, or execute stealth raids on rival convoys. With over 25 ship variants and 25+ upgrade choices, you’ll fine-tune engines, shields, weapons, and specialized modules to match your tactics—whether you’re a lightning-fast scout or a siege-ready dreadnought. Every loadout decision and alliance you forge shapes a living galaxy where your reputation is the ultimate currency.

Living Galaxy

AEXXOS’s universe runs on a living, player-driven economy—every resource you use comes from looting, trading, or conquering. Planets vary in what they offer: some lower-tier worlds yield raw ore, ammunition, and basic salvage, while more perilous systems reward daring captains with rare, high-grade materials. Pillage derelict ships for spare parts, conquer rival outposts to claim their stockpiles, or establish trade routes between star systems. As supply and demand shift, savvy captains buy low and sell high, turning battlefield loot into galactic influence.

Conquer the Galaxy

Forge your own path to supremacy: operate as a lone wolf carving out a reputation through daring raids and solo bounties, or ally with fellow captains in player-led corporations to seize control of star sectors rich in resources. Coordinate blockades against rival factions, plan synchronized assaults on orbital defenses, and defend your trade routes with fleet-wide tactics. Whether you’re staking a claim on a distant mining colony planet or rallying an armada to besiege an enemy stronghold, teamwork and strategic planning will determine who rules the galaxy—and whose legend endures among the stars.

Indie Passion Project

Born from the vision of a solo, dedicated indie developer, AEXXOS is our love letter to the classic MMOs of yesteryear and the communities that brought them to life. We’ve kept each feature intuitive for quick jump-in-and-play fun, while rewarding those who dive deeper with meaningful progression and discovery. And we’re only just getting started—this release lays the foundation for a universe we plan to expand and refine for years to come. Proudly self-funded and self-published, AEXXOS launches free of corporate influence and without any crowdfunding campaign—just pure passion driving every update. As a true passion project, we pledge to keep the universe growing—expect regular free updates, seasonal events, and fresh content drops as we build AEXXOS together with our players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 Home 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® iCore™ i3-530 or AMD® FX-6350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 460 or AMD® ATI Radeon™ HD 5870 (1GB VRAM), or AMD® Radeon™ RX Vega 11 or Intel® HD Graphics 4600
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 Home 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® iCore™ i5-3570K or AMD® Ryzen™ 5 2400G
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 560 Ti (1GB VRAM) or AMD® Radeon™ R7 370 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c-compatible sound card
